label: D-d5b6b4

defects.summary: The full MCP suite is red on this host: ATakeWhoseStreamCannotBeMade_ClosesItsDescriptor_AndLeavesTheFileFree fails although it passes at the start commit. The cause is most likely a fork race with its in-host inheritable descriptor, because the new round integration test starts real git children, but every new failure counts.
The file has 408 lines, and the story card says to split it into two files past 400 lines; this is not recorded in the §12 deviations.
S35 and S36 depend on a 300 ms Task.Delay for writer B to reach the lock while A holds it. If B starts later, the test still passes but does not show that B waited.
SpendLimitSentence parses the envelope again with its own try/catch, a copy of WhyItFailed's parse, when it could reuse that read and add only the 429 check.
The AGY_1_3_3 reason string is copied here as Agy133Reason and again in QuotaFixtures.Agy133Reason, when the shared fixture class could hold the only copy.

summary: The change delivers all four stories as the plan says: a three-valued Spent verdict, an AGY_ERROR reader for both shapes, the measured agy key table with Argon on its own key, a /quota reader with every edge case, a locked durable cooldown file that fails open and refuses writes out loud, per-key aggregation after the round, roster exclusion with this side's sentence, the providers wire member and the card line and badge. All 43 scenarios exist and pass, and the plan's deviations (§12) are true and give their reasons. The main mark against it is one new failure in the full MCP suite, in an unrelated HeldFile test that is probably a race; the other findings are small (file size, a timing-based interleave test, a few duplicates).
